dataset_metadata.dataset_name: AI Interview Prep - Sample Training Data
dataset_metadata.description: Each record = one interview question + a candidate's answer + the feedback an AI coach should give + scores. Used to teach an LLM how to evaluate answers and give real-time feedback.

deterministic_disclaimer: Deterministic settings (temperature=0.0, seed=42) minimize output variance but do not guarantee bit-level identity across OpenAI server clusters.
